description: Open-source CRM exposing REST and GraphQL APIs generated from each workspace schema.
auth_notes: Workspace-scoped bearer tokens generated in Settings Playground; OAuth 2.0 with authorization code plus PKCE and client credentials also documented.
gate_detail: Tokens are generated in workspace settings; sources do not state whether a free plan suffices. Custom roles for API keys need the Organization plan on Twenty Cloud; self-hosted includes them.
api_scope: REST and GraphQL APIs generated from each workspace schema; no static API reference. Rate limit 100 requests per minute, batches of 60 records.
mcp_notes: Twenty MCP server configured from Settings, AI, MCP; OAuth or API key header auth.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment gate is stated for tokens, but plan requirements for API access are not established.

evidence.quote: Send a Bearer token with each request:
Tokens can be generated in Settings → Playground and are workspace-scoped.
Authorization code flow with PKCE and client credentials for server-to-server access.
REST and GraphQL APIs generated from your workspace schema.
creating and assigning custom roles to members or API keys requires the Organization plan

uncertainties: Whether a free plan grants API token creation is not stated.
Webhooks and sandbox are not covered by the sources.
S4 text lacks an explicit statement that the MCP server is vendor-published beyond its own domain.
